_static_is_empty_on_purpose: This repository has no lint gate today. `[tool.ruff]` in pyproject.toml sets only
src, indent-width and exclude -- no rule selection -- and AGENTS.md's Commands
section names no lint command at all. Measured on develop 2026-09-14:
`ruff check .` reports 452 errors under ruff's default rules (tasks 106, tests 34,
scripts 49). Declaring that as the static rung would leave the gate red before the
first lap, so nothing could merge -- including the change that would make it pass.
Left empty, ci.py prints STATIC_SKIPPED, which is loud and true. Adopting a lint
gate is real work with a real triage cost and belongs in its own ticket.
_unit_note: CPU-only and needs no GPU: 225 passed, 1 skipped in ~40s on develop (2026-09-14),
237 passed on feat/hop-env-training. The count is evidence, not a threshold --
see FACTORY_RULES.md. ci.py still fails on a suite that discovers zero tests.
description: Ordinary project checks only. Training is never a check: it costs money and is human-launched. See .factory/policy.json.
